comparison.objective: Place two cans so they cover five posts; candidate fractures and retrieves HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-post coverage through can placement differs from coaxial mandrel manipulation, hammer impact, fracture regulation, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Five posts covered by two cans is stated, but coverage tolerances and setup are absent. Candidate requires four notch fractures, four tray-contained tangs, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Coverage planning and placement are meaningfully different from insert tang break-off.
